entities.summary: Xavier ("Xavi") Arnau Creus is a former field hockey player from Spain. He won the silver medal with the men's national team at the 1996 Summer Olympics in Atlanta, Georgia. The striker also participated in the 1992 Summer Olympics and the 2000 Summer Olympics. Javier Arnau was a athletes & competitors from Terrassa (b. 1973-03-20, Terrassa). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
